title: The Door to the Pass
hook: Hold eastbound. She is not cleared for the pass.
scene: Clear cold morning on a two-lane street at the last downtown block, heading east. The Menace is in the eastbound travel lane, on wet asphalt between the lane paint and the right curb. The full-width nose plow sits on the front bull bar and points east. Behind the car, west, brick downtown blocks and the last intersection meet the sidewalk of this same street. Ahead, east, the same two-lane continues with wet paint and no other playable vehicles. Both cats are a sound in the closed carrier on the floor. Hold. You are not cleared for the pass.
debrief: Downtown sits behind the Beetle. The eastbound travel lane continues ahead. She is not cleared for the pass.

source.teaching_target: Hold the eastbound at the last downtown block; city on the left shares that street; empty eastbound continues right; she is not cleared for the pass.
